missing_minimal_prerequisites: A uniform law of large numbers or Glivenko-Cantelli supplier is needed to turn the conditional M/Z consistency theorem into concrete guarantees for indexed criteria; ordinary SLLN and empirical-measure weak convergence are not uniform over arbitrary criterion classes.

A vector-valued Slutsky/joint convergence supplier is absent; the existing Slutsky item is stated for real variables. The statistical CLT and delta/Z results are vector-valued, so supply a vector Slutsky result or prove the needed special case inside those theorem proofs.

Statistical experiment/model, parameter/estimand, estimator, likelihood, score, Fisher information, QMD/LAN, contiguity, and regularity/efficiency definitions are all missing as library items and must be introduced before their results.
Regular likelihood-ratio testing/Wilks uses the nested-hypothesis and null-test conventions supplied by foundations-02; boundary examples must not depend on later models/experiments categories.
